photos.alt: A woman with long auburn hair sits beside a tall bright window in a white studio, wearing an off-the-shoulder floral organza dress with puffed sleeves.
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3, soft window light. The tall bright window and grey curtain sit on the left and a plain white wall fills the upper right, so a split hero (text left, photo right) works, or a full-bleed crop at 70% 45% with a light overlay. Faces the camera, so keep the crop above the knees. Best fit for the blush and cream mood; spare-1 is the landscape alternative.

photos.alt: A smiling woman in a sleeveless blue-and-white floral halter dress with a tie waist and ruffled hem stands on a sunlit woodland path.
photos.notes: Portrait, dress fully visible from collar to hem. Works as the dress product card, the Dresses category tile or a second hero. Blue florals contrast nicely with a blush palette; keep the whole dress in a 4:5 crop.

photos.alt: A woman, head cropped at the hair, in a cream cable-knit cardigan with tortoiseshell buttons and a floral midi skirt holds a bunch of white daisies in a golden barley field.
photos.colors: cream, oat, wheat gold, daisy white
photos.notes: Portrait about 4:5, golden-hour field. Faceless (the head is cropped at the hair), so safe for the Knitwear tile or a product card. The cable-knit fills the centre: a 4:5 or square crop at 50% 40% keeps the buttons and the daisies. Warmer and more golden than the blush palette, so pair it with the sage accent.

photos.alt: Close-up of a woman in a white broderie-trimmed blouse with a ruffled collar and cuffs, one hand resting at her chest wearing a ring; her face is cropped below the lips.
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3, bright and clean. Detail-led product shot with no identifiable face; works at 4:5 or square around the collar and hand.

photos.alt: A yellow and orange patterned silk scarf, loosely twisted into a loop, rests on a white shirt against a white background.
photos.notes: Tall portrait, lots of clean white space around the scarf. The yellow is the one warm accent in the set; good for a sunny product card on a cream card background.

photos.alt: A woman in a white shirt and long white skirt, face cropped at the lips, carries a woven seagrass tote with a black woven band, filled with pink blossoms, across a bright green lawn.
photos.colors: straw tan, white, spring green, pink
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3. Keep the tote and the blossoms in frame; at square crop use position 35% 55%. Fresh and spring-like, pairs well with the sage accent.

photos.alt: A pair of gold-and-pearl stud earrings, each a faceted gold nugget with a large freshwater pearl drop, rest on a warm peach surface with dappled sunlight shadows.
photos.notes: Square, warm editorial light with soft shadows. Already a ready-made product-card crop for the Jewellery tile; keep the earrings in the lower middle (55% 58%) when it is cropped wider. The textured light gives the page a premium feel.

photos.alt: Handmade white linen snap hair clips embroidered with coral, cream and olive-green flowers and sprigs, laid out in two diagonal rows on a pale warm-grey surface, seen from above.
photos.colors: cream white, coral, olive green, warm grey
photos.notes: Portrait 3:4, top-down on a seamless pale backdrop, no text or logos. A handmade product shot that suits the "thread" half of the brand; square crop at 50% 50% keeps both rows of clips. Soft shadows, so it sits well on a cream card background.

photos.alt: Top view of a pair of cream ballet flats embroidered with pink and turquoise beaded flowers, resting on gathered pink fabric.
photos.notes: Portrait 3:4, shot from above. The pink-on-pink floral detail suits the coquette style; crop to 4:5 and keep both toes visible.

photos.alt: Overhead view of a white leather crossbody bag with the flap open, showing tortoiseshell sunglasses and a floral wallet beside a blush pouch, resting on chunky cream knitwear.
photos.notes: Square 1:1, shot from above in bright soft light, with no text and no readable logos. Good for the Accessories tile, a newsletter band or a lookbook strip; the chunky knit gives texture and the white bag keeps it feminine without being sugary.

photos.alt: A bright minimalist boutique interior with a rail of cream and oat linen clothes on wooden hangers, a tall cactus, a concrete pillar and curved boucle chairs.
photos.notes: Tall portrait, airy and calm. Use it beside the "our story" copy as a tall image; it also makes a good shop-floor atmosphere shot.

photos.alt: A white gift box wrapped in paper printed with tiny gold motifs and topped with a pink satin pull-bow sits on a wooden table in front of a lavender-print wrapped present.
photos.notes: Tall portrait, soft daylight. Keep the bow in the middle of the crop; works for the Gifts tile and the gift-wrapping upsell in the cart drawer.

photos.alt: A woman in a pink-and-cream floral sweetheart dress and straw hat sits on weathered white wooden steps beside a wicker basket of daisies and market produce, in tan suede loafers.
photos.notes: Landscape 3:2 editorial lookbook shot, sharp and softly lit: the landscape alternative to the portrait hero. The subject is centred, so for a full-bleed hero lay a soft white gradient over one side (the white stair rails take text well) or use a split layout. Crop to 16:9 at 52% 40% to keep the face, hat and basket.

photos.alt: Soft-focus pink and white watercolour-floral wrapping paper on a pale blue-grey ground, with a pink ribbon on the corner of a gift box at the top left.
photos.notes: Texture shot: use it as a background for the newsletter or announcement band with a light overlay, or as a pattern behind the gift section. Almost no subject, so text sits on it easily.

photos.alt: A woman, seen from behind, clips a cream satin bow barrette into her long chestnut hair, with golden sunlit foliage blurred behind.
photos.notes: Atmosphere shot with warm light and no face. Good as an editorial strip between sections or a second hair-accessories image (the hairclips slot holds the embroidered clips).
